[b]・Improved the following points

- Improved the game settings in the online lobby to allow chat settings.

・The following problems have been fixed

notes.title: Plans for Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Custom Mech Wars.

We are currently working on a patch for the problems reported by our users, including problems related to online multiplayer, or investigating the cause of the problems.
We plan to update the software one by one, starting with those bugs for which the cause has been identified and are ready to be fixed.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could update to the latest version before playing the game.

We would appreciate it if you could report any problems to the following thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328310/discussions/0/6252749165563847264/

Thank you for your continued support of CUSTOM MECH WARS.

Team CMW

notes.title: “CUSTOM MECH WARS” Pre‑order Now on Steam!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/9451fa602706c67e2e35fcbcd9311d447c645134.png[/img]

"CUSTOM MECH WARS" will be released on [b]December 14th, 2023[/b]! Pre-order is now available on Steam Store!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/55c6fcb31e65af1c8dc5e4d27a97c7f2d3b50855.jpg[/img]
The early purchase bonus is a "Head parts: Girl head" that can be used to customize your Mech.

[h3]Collaboration with EARTH DEFENSE FORCE series! Vehicles from EDF will join the battle as downloadable content![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/605d9312d500036f0aeb5058dadf40e37dca7ece.jpg[/img]
A collaboration with D3PUBLISHER‘s popular TPS [b]“EARTH DEFENSE FORCES”[/b] series has been announced! The “Gigantic Unloader Barga” and many other powerful vehicles from the EDF series will join CMW as collaborative downloadable content.

[h3]A total of 70 accessory parts & custom voices! DLC "OMEGA CUSTOMIZATION SET" including camouflage of anime game characters will also be available![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/ded6a82674eae3e475df3b2deabbbc3e31ffa130.jpg[/img]
A large volume of downloadable content, "OMEGA CUSTOMIZATION SET" will be released, which includes 70 types of girls' game collaboration accessory parts and a custom voice that allows you to change the voice of the navigation AI.
